name: abap2ui5-app
description: abap2UI5 app project - the gates that check it without an SAP system.

scripts.check: npm run check:abap && npm run check:abap2ui5
scripts.check:all: npm run check:pin && npm run check

//: watch and watch:render need the linter's --watch flag, which arrives with the @abap2ui5/linter release after 0.6.1 - the ^0.6.1 pinned here does not have it yet, so until the devDependency is bumped past it both scripts print the linter's `unknown option '--watch'` and exit 2 (`npm run doctor` says which). JSON has no comments; npm ignores this key.
